443:t_2:23.en:
$$レド$$
(Then the world $$エイミー$$ and I came from is...)

443:t_2:24.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ティファ$$... Please use your power to call to $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$.」

443:t_2:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「But... During the $$多元戦争$$, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ chose to sleep of his own free will...」

443:t_2:26.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Thank you, $$ティファ$$. You respect his wishes.」

443:t_2:27.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But the time has come for him and me to fulfill another mission.」

443:t_2:29.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That is also the history behind $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$'s birth.」

443:t_2:30.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...I understand. I can feel your extraordinary resolve, Queen $$ディアナ$$.」

443:t_2:31.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I'm sure $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ feels the same way.」

443:t_2:32.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you sure you're all right, $$ティファ$$?」

443:t_2:33.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I too... want to do what I can for this world, together with $$ガロード$$.」

443:t_2:34.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Then I'm counting on you, $$ティファ$$.」

443:t_2:35.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$... Please answer my feelings.」

443:t_2:36.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Here and now, in the name of the mission entrusted to me by my forebears, I demand the truth of you.」

443:t_2:40.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「...It's been a long time, $$ティファ$$.」

443:t_2:42.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It's all right. I too sensed that this day would come eventually.」

443:t_2:43.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I know about your situation and Earth's. I went to sleep, but I didn't shut out information from outside...」

443:t_2:44.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Besides, I now have a reassuring companion.」

443:t_2:45.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What do you mean, a companion...?」

443:t_2:46.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「We'll discuss that in due time. First... there are people I must greet.」

443:t_2:49.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Are you talking about us, by any chance?」

443:t_2:50.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I am honored that one who sleeps on the Moon knows of us.」

443:t_2:51.en:
$$レド$$
「...You said your name was $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$. Was our world... the $$残されの海$$, part of the world you lived in?」

443:t_2:52.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. Welcome, guardians of the green sea, and descendant of our brethren who has returned from the galaxy.」

443:t_2:53.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet's people are from the same world as us...?!」

443:t_2:54.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I heard the $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the fleet came from the same Earth, but you're saying that Earth is $$ＵＣＷ$$'s future too?!」

443:t_2:55.en:
$$レド$$
「...It's true. I found data confirming it in the ruins in the $$霧の海$$.」

443:t_2:56.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You! Why didn't you tell us?!」

443:t_2:58.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Stop it, $$ピニオン$$. I'm sure $$レド$$ had his reasons.」

443:t_2:60.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I understand his feelings. For those who left Earth to seek a new home in the galaxy, Earth also gave birth to their mortal enemies.」

443:t_2:61.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Could you explain it in order, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$?」

443:t_2:63.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「As you already know, the era called $$黒歴史$$ began with $$シャア・アズナブル$$ dropping $$アクシズ$$.」

443:t_2:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(A future in which Colonel $$シャア$$ and Captain $$アムロ$$ fight...)

443:t_2:66.en:
$$シン$$
(So the $$時獄戦役$$ was following that path, at least on the surface...)

443:t_2:67.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That brought a nuclear winter to Earth. But even then, humanity did not stop waging war.」

443:t_2:68.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Nor were those wars only among humans. Humanity kept fighting many outside enemies, including aliens.」

443:t_2:69.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And in the end, the $$月光蝶$$ buried human civilization.」

443:t_2:70.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Yes. But before it reached that point, humanity tried various ways to restore Earth's environment.」

443:t_2:71.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「One was using nanomachines to remove ocean pollution... Commonly known as the $$翠星蟲計画$$.」

443:t_2:72.en:
$$レド$$
「So those are the nanomachines in the $$残されの海$$...」

443:t_2:73.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Exactly. And the $$ガルガンティア$$ was one of the ships built to study and improve the marine environment.」

443:t_2:74.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Their mission was to live at sea and restore the environment of the ocean, the mother of life.」

443:t_2:75.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So... our ancestors were there...」

443:t_2:76.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I see... So that is what the name $$残されの海$$ meant.」

443:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But in the end, the $$月光蝶$$ caused human civilization to decline...」

443:t_2:78.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Perhaps I should say there was no choice but to do so.」

443:t_2:80.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But before the $$月光蝶$$ activated, one group abandoned the polluted Earth to seek a new home in the galaxy.」

443:t_2:81.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「They called themselves $$イボルバー$$ and tried to evolve artificially to adapt to their environment.」

443:t_2:83.en:
$$レド$$
「...That's what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are.」

443:t_2:85.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You're saying the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are what humans became...?!」

443:t_2:86.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Then... the $$クジライカ$$ were originally human too...」

443:t_2:87.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes. They adapted to Earth's oceans, so their combat strength was low, but...」

443:t_2:88.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ kept evolving to suit the harsh environment of space, gaining immense vitality.」

443:t_2:89.en:
$$レド$$
「But at the same time, they decided life's fundamental purpose was survival, and abandoned intelligence and civilization...」

443:t_2:90.en:
$$ルカ$$
「So those are... the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ we saw...」

443:t_2:91.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But once they've gone that far, you can't call them human anymore...」

443:t_2:92.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$ said the same thing. The $$人類銀河同盟$$'s leaders probably fight the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ on that same judgment.」

443:t_2:93.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$... You ended up carrying such a huge secret after the $$霧の海$$...」

443:t_2:94.en:
$$レド$$
「I... killed the $$クジライカ$$... who were once my own people...」

443:t_2:95.en:
$$レド$$
「No... Even before that, I'd killed more $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ than I can count...」

443:t_2:97.en:
$n
「That's right. I'm not just trying to comfort you. Both sides fought for survival. No one was to blame.」

443:t_2:99.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I agree with what everyone is saying.」

443:t_2:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And learning that truth let you reconsider your own way of life, beyond your role as a soldier.」

443:t_2:101.en:
$$レド$$
「...I think I only learned to think for myself when everything I believed in crumbled at its foundations.」

443:t_2:103.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you can now recognize your own will, think about what comes next.」

443:t_2:104.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Start thinking now about what to do the next time you encounter the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」
